name: assemblyai
description: Transcribe recorded audio with AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 and read transcripts, sentences, subtitles and word searches.
long_description: Use your AssemblyAI API key to transcribe recorded audio and video with the AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 speech model (set `speech_models` to `["assemblyai-stt-3-7"]`; it is also the default for accounts created on or after 2026-11-17) without storing the key on your Sprite. A Sprite can upload media, submit transcription requests, poll transcripts, and read sentences, paragraphs, SRT or VTT subtitles, word searches and redacted audio, and delete a transcript's data. Saving or testing a key lists at most one existing transcript and creates nothing. Only the US pre-recorded API at api.assemblyai.com is forwarded: the EU host, streaming (WebSocket), Sync, Dictation, Text-to-Speech, LLM Gateway and Speech Understanding over LLM Gateway live on other hosts and are not forwarded.

examples.title: Transcribe a provider-hosted sample with AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 (charged by AssemblyAI)
notes: The response is the queued transcript; poll GET /v2/transcript/ID until status is completed.
Add "universal-2" after "assemblyai-stt-3-7" in speech_models to fall back for languages STT-3.7 does not cover.

examples.title: SRT subtitles; replace TRANSCRIPT_ID
notes: The response is text/plain; use /vtt for WebVTT.

messages.400: AssemblyAI rejected the request (%{status}); check the body, parameters and that the transcript id exists
messages.401: AssemblyAI API key is invalid or revoked; replace it in this connection
messages.404: AssemblyAI did not find that resource
messages.429: AssemblyAI rate limit reached; wait for the Retry-After header and try again
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach AssemblyAI; retry later

presentation.tagline: Transcribe audio with AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at assemblyai.com, open the dashboard's API keys page and copy or create a key, then paste it here. Keys are sent as the bare value of the Authorization header.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing a key lists at most one existing transcript (`GET /v2/transcript?limit=1`) and costs nothing. Every `POST /v2/transcript` is charged by AssemblyAI per hour of audio for the chosen speech model (AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is priced per hour; see assemblyai.com/pricing), and add-ons such as speaker labels, PII redaction or speech understanding options in the request may cost extra. Polling `GET /v2/transcript/:id` is limited to 60 requests per minute per transcript.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Forwards the pre-recorded speech-to-text API at `api.assemblyai.com`: `POST /v2/upload`, `GET`/`POST /v2/transcript`, `GET`/`DELETE /v2/transcript/:id` and its `/sentences`, `/paragraphs`, `/srt`, `/vtt`, `/word-search` and `/redacted-audio` routes. The EU host (`api.eu.assemblyai.com`), streaming speech-to-text (WebSocket), Sync, Dictation, Text-to-Speech, LLM Gateway and Speech Understanding over LLM Gateway are on other hosts and are not forwarded.

notices.title: Model and data
notices.body: Set `speech_models` to `["assemblyai-stt-3-7"]` to pin the AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 model; it keeps disfluencies by default, so set `disfluencies` to `false` for clean text. `DELETE /v2/transcript/:id` removes the transcript's data and any file uploaded for it from AssemblyAI. Uploads go through the gateway's request body limit; a publicly reachable `audio_url` avoids it.

usage_notes.title: Upload a local media file
usage_notes.body: From a Sprite allowed to use this connection, set `ASSEMBLYAI_GATEWAY_URL` to the connection's gateway URL and replace `recording.mp3` with your file path. Run `curl -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --data-binary '@recording.mp3' "${ASSEMBLYAI_GATEWAY_URL%/}/v2/upload"`. Pass the returned `upload_url` as `audio_url` to `POST /v2/transcript`. For files above the gateway's request body limit, use a publicly reachable `audio_url`.
